findings.quote: Δύο διαδοχικά νομίσματα έχουν τα πρόσωπά τους αντικριστά ακριβώς όταν εμφανίζεται το ζεύγος \(HT\): το κάτω μέρος του επάνω νομίσματος και το πάνω μέρος του επόμενου έχουν τότε πρόσωπο.
findings.explanation: With H defined to mean that a coin's upper side bears the face, an upper coin marked H has no face on its lower side. Reading the stack from top to bottom, face-to-face contact instead occurs for TH: the upper T coin has its face underneath and the lower H coin has its face on top. Thus the forbidden transition and claimed allowable sequence form are reversed. The final count remains 9 by symmetry, so 630 is still correct. The reference solution contains the same orientation error.
findings.suggested_action: Correct the forbidden adjacent pair to TH and describe the allowed orientations as a block of H symbols followed by a block of T symbols, while retaining the valid count of 9 and final answer 630.
